what: Destination-staging transfer for pins-planning-appeal-outcome: copy the five accepted pins-planning-002 artifact files (artifact c861bd8f4acd9bbe267bdb58e1168996fdb359c540aaf4030030a632d693c527) from private staging release 430108320 into the private dataset repository earino/pins-planning-appeal-outcome draft release v2026.10 (430215294), under the flat asset names the download helper restores. Each asset is verified against its recorded sha256 on arrival and against the server's own digest after upload; peak worker disk is one asset (37.4 MB total), so the bytes never approach the coordinator. Source asset ids were resolved by sha256 match against the staging release's worker-written manifest.json, not hand-copied.
